prism_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Nutanix Prism Element/Cluster (e.g., prism.example.com or 10.0.0.5). Required for API access.

prism_port.description: HTTPS port of the Nutanix Prism API. Typically 9440 (secure) or 8080 (non-secure, deprecated).

username.description: Prism username with appropriate permissions (e.g., 'prism-admin' or 'cluster-admin'). Required.

password.description: Plain-text password for Prism authentication. For security, prefer `password_script`.

password_script.description: Path to an executable script that outputs the password to stdout (e.g., for vault integration). Safer than plain-text.

insecure.description: If true, disables SSL certificate verification (dangerous in production). Only use in test environments.

use_ssl.description: If false, uses unencrypted HTTP instead of HTTPS. Not recommended.

api_version.description: Prism API version to use (e.g., 'v1', 'v2', 'v3', 'v4'). Leave blank to auto-detect the latest supported.

cluster_uuid.description: UUID of the Nutanix cluster (optional but helpful in multi-cluster Prism deployments).

vm_uuid.description: UUID of the VM to fence. If omitted, must be passed via command line or environment.

vm_name.description: Name of the VM to fence (alternative to vm_uuid). May be ambiguous if VMs share names.

retries.description: Number of times to retry failed fencing operations before giving up.

retry_sleep.description: Seconds to wait between fencing retry attempts.
